sample_contract.deterministic_selection: First 100 most-recent address-history results from a fixed end, output chronological. No status/signer/route filter.
sample_contract.inclusion: Outer Settler instruction only. This labels 0x Settler execution, not 0x Swap API execution.

CONFIRMED_API_SPECIFIC.marker: 0x Dashboard onchain tagging, when an integrator has enabled it for its own app
CONFIRMED_API_SPECIFIC.evidence: First-party FAQ identifies this as the supported way to make an app’s transactions easier to filter/trace.
CONFIRMED_API_SPECIFIC.limitation: Not observed in this public sample and not a way to identify every public Swap API transaction.

SETTLER_SPECIFIC_BUT_NOT_API_SPECIFIC.evidence: 100/100 returned address-history rows have a locally verified outer Settler instruction.
SETTLER_SPECIFIC_BUT_NOT_API_SPECIFIC.limitation: First-party FAQ: Settler activity is not a canonical Swap API-origin flag.

POSSIBLE.marker: Settler instruction data / ordered accounts / ALTs / fee-account patterns
POSSIBLE.limitation: 0x documentation says no canonical onchain API-origin tag; do not use these patterns for API attribution.

REJECTED.marker: zid as a public onchain origin marker
REJECTED.reason: The API documents zid as a request identifier, while first-party FAQ says there is no canonical onchain API-origin tag.

REJECTED.marker: generic route DEX programs or Compute Budget instructions
REJECTED.reason: Shared Solana transaction components; not 0x API-specific.

parser_assessment.package_scope: 0xProject describes @0x/0x-parser as parsing 0x transactions from EVM blockchains. No first-party Solana support evidence was found in this probe.
